reviews.title: Little pricey but good investment.
reviews.comment: 1. They can be whisper quiet and do a decent job; although, I'd recommend setting a fan curve for optimal balance between airflow during peak CPU utilization and quiet during light workloads. 2. They are effective at airflow and pressure making them a true jack of all trades. 3. Not as powerful as the 140mm fans but much quieter when ramping up but bottom end is still whisper quiet. I'm currently running these as exhaust fans for the case so that my poor GPU can get some fresher air. Mind you I barely notice these fans even with open back headphones, massively better than the ones that came with the case.
reviews.author: Bryton Massie

reviews.title: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Best 120 mm Fans I’ve Ever Bought — Quiet, Powerful, and Perfect for Push-Pull!
reviews.comment: These Noctua G2 fans absolutely deliver. The dual-fan set with slightly offset RPMs makes a noticeable difference in airflow smoothness and acoustic profile — especially in push-pull radiator setups or when mounted side-by-side, reducing that annoying harmonic buzz you can get with identical fans. The build quality is top-tier, with precision engineering that keeps noise super low even under load, and the airflow/pressure balance is excellent for both case airflow and radiator cooling. Compared to other fans I’ve owned, these are quieter and more efficient without sacrificing performance. If you want high-end PC cooling that actually lives up to the hype, this set is worth every penny.
reviews.author: zenny

reviews.title: Greatest Quiet Fan there is! Especially for AIO's and CPU Air Coolers
reviews.comment: In my Opinion the Noctua NF-A12x25 G2 are the Greatest, Performance, Quiet fans on the Market.  They have the power to cool the most powerful components currently on the market while staying some of the quietest fans you can purchase. They come with vibration Pads for the front and rear of the fans, Rubber Mounting Studs, Cable extensions, and a Y-Splitter making for simple installation without having to purchase anything additional.  They have only two negative issues In my opinion.  The are not available in Reverse Blade configuration, and they do not have an RGB option.  So if your looking for awesome Performance, and an ultra quiet PC system look no further.
